LESSON: WRITING 1.4.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Writing 1.4.1 Functional writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 1.4.1 Functional writing, part of Strand 1 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why should one be careful when filling in forms? 2. What information do we fill in forms?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. fill forms provided by the teacher with specific details such as: Personal details Name ______ Grade _______ Date of Birth _________ School Details Name _______ Address ______ Name of Class Teacher _______ Name of Head teacher ________,

2. read instructions on filling in forms collaboratively,

3. record the required information related to the theme in the forms with peers,

4. team up to fill in forms in print format and display them,

5. download online forms and fill in information with guidance from the teacher,

6. create a form, and type it on a computer, laptop or tablet. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. fill forms provided by the teacher with specific details such as: Personal details Name ______ Grade _______ Date of Birth _________ School Details Name _______ Address ______ Name of Class Teacher _______ Name of Head teacher ________,
2. read instructions on filling in forms collaboratively,
3. record the required information related to the theme in the forms with peers,
4. team up to fill in forms in print format and display them,
5. download online forms and fill in information with guidance from the teacher,
6. create a form, and type it on a computer, laptop or tablet. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 1.4.1 Functional writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: This is promoted as the learner generates ideas and uses them to create a form and shares it

with peers.

• Digital Literacy: It is enhanced as the learner manipulates digital devices to download, create and fill in forms.

Values:
● Love: This is promoted as the learner accommodates other’s contributions as they work jointly to fill in forms.

● Integrity : This is promoted as the learner willingly displays their forms for peer review and feedback.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Gender Education: This is promoted as the learner interacts with content about the various people and genders in the theme

of family.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner is able to relate the concept of filling in forms to their learning in Kiswahili.
